in_marathi.name: Arnesh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Earth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Arnesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Arnesh is a Sanskrit name derived from the term ‘Anesha’ which means the lord of the earth. This name is popular in Hindu culture and is considered an auspicious name for boys.
